subject: E-Commerce
title: Same-Day Delivery Race
description: Learn Same-Day Delivery Race in one minute.

hook.text: Amazon promised two-day shipping. Then one-day. Then same-day. Now competitors must match or die.

buildup.text: Same-day delivery requires micro-fulfillment centers close to customers. Amazon has 1,000+ US warehouses.

discovery.text: Walmart uses its 4,700 stores as fulfillment centers. Existing stores became the delivery advantage.

twist.text: Speed costs money. The average last-mile delivery costs $10. Most same-day orders don't cover it.

climax.text: Delivery speed is now a competitive moat. The company with the most warehouses wins the most customers.

punchline.text: Two-day, then one-day, now same-day. Speed became the new loyalty.

quiz.question: How does Walmart compete with Amazon on delivery speed?
